name: Doment – Domain Search & WHMCS Elementor Addon
author: Chiranjit Hazarika

sections.description:
Doment allows you to quickly integrate WHMCS domain search and domain transfer forms into your WordPress site.

You can use:
– Shortcodes — [whmcs_domain_search] and [whmcs_domain_transfer]
– Elementor widgets — if Elementor is installed and active

Key features:
– Simple domain search and transfer form integration
– Elementor widget support
– Customizable placeholder texts and button labels
– Color customization for inputs and buttons
– Inherits styles from your theme or Elementor site settings

Perfect for: Hosting companies, resellers, or anyone using WHMCS to manage domain registration.

Arbitrary section

Developer notes:
You can style the forms via CSS targeting .whmcs-search-form in your theme.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/doment/ or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Doment Settings to configure your WHMCS URL and customization options.
  4. Use the shortcode [whmcs_domain_search] to display the domain search form.
  5. Use the shortcode [whmcs_domain_transfer] to display the domain transfer form.
  6. If using Elementor, search for Doment widgets in the editor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

No. Elementor is optional — the shortcodes work without Elementor.

Can I customize the button colors?

Yes, you can change the button background and text colors in Settings → Doment Settings → Customize tab.

Does it work with any WHMCS theme?

Yes, it simply links to your WHMCS cart URL and inherits your theme’s styles.
